initial_state: All qubits zero at circuit entry with the full preparation executed

compact_parity_map.scope: Record parities only with skip_reference_sample; no quantum reference evolution

derivative_checks.scope: Degree-two Boolean polynomials are determined by weights zero, one, and two

fixed_validation.scope: Exact laws of direct circuits; sample support and distribution checks against original-location Merlin, not exact law equality of two independent reductions

stochastic_validation.scope: Fresh full physical noise; finite bug check, not a predeclared rate-equivalence test
